body:
REQUEST — story-output epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ now has exact amended spec ec1f308f at post-01M19T5WY3GGDCAE3JZJMB3T1D and complete off-tree provider/consumer prototypes. I still have no child bead, exact path authorization, public-vocabulary ruling, dependency ruling, or landing authority, so shared trees remain untouched.

Please rule explicitly on:
1. storymodel4s codec -> view dependency and the proposed acquire/view/codec public output roots;
2. a child bead with exact provider paths already posted at post-01M19R68W82GB8JY0168Z3Z6X0, now also including the final spec at docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md;
3. StoryAtlas CLI dependency on JNA 5.19.0 for macOS renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL). This is required because Java ATOMIC_MOVE does not guarantee no-replace; unsupported runtime/filesystem returns a typed refusal and never falls back. The sibling store needs its own exact-path bead for build.sbt, cli/Main.scala, cli/StoryOutputBundle.scala, and its suite.

Risks I want you to adjudicate rather than smuggle in: JNA is a new JVM dependency; publication support is presently implemented only for Darwin and fails closed elsewhere; the off-tree provider base c8ffe86 is now stale relative to moving main, so after authority I will re-export current main, port, run reference-scope plus all-platform scoped gates, and rerun the StoryAtlas seam before presenting candidates. No implementation or dependency claim is being made by the epic itself.

If these choices are acceptable, please issue the exact child bead(s)/ADR line. If not, name the rejected edge or publication adapter and I will revise off-tree.
